<?php
// authentication.php - Original bulky implementation

// Database connection setup
function getDatabaseConnection() {
    $servername = "localhost";
    $username = "root";
    $password = "password123";
    $dbname = "user_system";
    
    $conn = new mysqli($servername, $username, $password, $dbname);
    
    if ($conn->connect_error) {
        error_log("Database connection failed: " . $conn->connect_error);
        return null;
    }
    
    return $conn;
}

// Check if user exists by email
function checkUserExists($email) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return false;
    }
    
    $email = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $email);
    $sql = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = '$email'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    $exists = $result && $result->num_rows > 0;
    $conn->close();
    
    return $exists;
}

// Get user by email
function getUserByEmail($email) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return null;
    }
    
    $email = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $email);
    $sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '$email'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result && $result->num_rows > 0) {
        $user = $result->fetch_assoc();
        $conn->close();
        return $user;
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return null;
}

// Get user by ID
function getUserById($userId) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return null;
    }
    
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $userId);
    $sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '$userId'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result && $result->num_rows > 0) {
        $user = $result->fetch_assoc();
        $conn->close();
        return $user;
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return null;
}

// Verify password
function verifyPassword($password, $hash) {
    if (function_exists('password_verify')) {
        return password_verify($password, $hash);
    } else {
        // Fallback for older PHP versions
        return md5($password) === $hash;
    }
}

// Hash password
function hashPassword($password) {
    if (function_exists('password_hash')) {
        return password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    } else {
        return md5($password);
    }
}

// Generate session token
function generateSessionToken() {
    return bin2hex(openssl_random_pseudo_bytes(32));
}

// Create session
function createSession($userId) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return null;
    }
    
    $token = generateSessionToken();
    $expiresAt = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + (30 * 60)); // 30 minutes
    
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $userId);
    $token = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $token);
    $expiresAt = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $expiresAt);
    
    $sql = "INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, token, expires_at, created_at) VALUES ('$userId', '$token', '$expiresAt', NOW())";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result) {
        $sessionId = $conn->insert_id;
        $conn->close();
        return array('session_id' => $sessionId, 'token' => $token);
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return null;
}

// Validate session
function validateSession($token) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return null;
    }
    
    $token = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $token);
    $sql = "SELECT s.*, u.* FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.token = '$token' AND s.expires_at > NOW()";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result && $result->num_rows > 0) {
        $session = $result->fetch_assoc();
        $conn->close();
        return $session;
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return null;
}

// Destroy session
function destroySession($token) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return false;
    }
    
    $token = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $token);
    $sql = "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token = '$token'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    $success = $result !== false;
    $conn->close();
    
    return $success;
}

// Clean expired sessions
function cleanExpiredSessions() {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return false;
    }
    
    $sql = "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < NOW()";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    $success = $result !== false;
    $conn->close();
    
    return $success;
}

// Login user
function loginUser($email, $password) {
    $user = getUserByEmail($email);
    if (!$user) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid credentials');
    }
    
    if (!verifyPassword($password, $user['password'])) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid credentials');
    }
    
    // Check if user is active
    if (isset($user['status']) && $user['status'] !== 'active') {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Account is not active');
    }
    
    // Clean old expired sessions first
    cleanExpiredSessions();
    
    // Create new session
    $session = createSession($user['id']);
    if (!$session) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to create session');
    }
    
    return array(
        'success' => true,
        'message' => 'Login successful',
        'user' => array(
            'id' => $user['id'],
            'email' => $user['email'],
            'name' => isset($user['name']) ? $user['name'] : ''
        ),
        'session' => $session
    );
}

// Register user
function registerUser($email, $password, $name) {
    // Check if user already exists
    if (checkUserExists($email)) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Email already registered');
    }
    
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Database connection failed');
    }
    
    $hashedPassword = hashPassword($password);
    
    $email = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $email);
    $name = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $name);
    $hashedPassword = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $hashedPassword);
    
    $sql = "INSERT INTO users (email, password, name, status, created_at) VALUES ('$email', '$hashedPassword', '$name', 'active', NOW())";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result) {
        $userId = $conn->insert_id;
        $conn->close();
        return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Registration successful', 'user_id' => $userId);
    } else {
        $conn->close();
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Registration failed');
    }
}

// Logout user
function logoutUser($token) {
    $result = destroySession($token);
    
    if ($result) {
        return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Logout successful');
    } else {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Logout failed');
    }
}

// Get current user from session
function getCurrentUser($token) {
    $session = validateSession($token);
    
    if (!$session) {
        return null;
    }
    
    return array(
        'id' => $session['id'],
        'email' => $session['email'],
        'name' => isset($session['name']) ? $session['name'] : ''
    );
}

// Reset password request
function requestPasswordReset($email) {
    $user = getUserByEmail($email);
    if (!$user) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'User not found');
    }
    
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Database connection failed');
    }
    
    $token = generateSessionToken();
    $expiresAt = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + (60 * 60)); // 1 hour
    
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $user['id']);
    $token = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $token);
    $expiresAt = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $expiresAt);
    
    $sql = "INSERT INTO password_resets (user_id, token, expires_at, created_at) VALUES ('$userId', '$token', '$expiresAt', NOW())";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result) {
        $conn->close();
        // In a real app, send email here
        return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Password reset email sent', 'token' => $token);
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to create reset token');
}

// Reset password
function resetPassword($token, $newPassword) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Database connection failed');
    }
    
    $token = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $token);
    $sql = "SELECT * FROM password_resets WHERE token = '$token' AND expires_at > NOW()";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if (!$result || $result->num_rows === 0) {
        $conn->close();
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid or expired token');
    }
    
    $reset = $result->fetch_assoc();
    $userId = $reset['user_id'];
    
    $hashedPassword = hashPassword($newPassword);
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $userId);
    $hashedPassword = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $hashedPassword);
    
    // Update password
    $sql = "UPDATE users SET password = '$hashedPassword', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '$userId'";
    $conn->query($sql);
    
    // Delete used token
    $sql = "DELETE FROM password_resets WHERE token = '$token'";
    $conn->query($sql);
    
    $conn->close();
    return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Password reset successful');
}

// Update user profile
function updateUserProfile($userId, $name, $email) {
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Database connection failed');
    }
    
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $userId);
    $name = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $name);
    $email = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $email);
    
    $sql = "UPDATE users SET name = '$name', email = '$email', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '$userId'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result) {
        $conn->close();
        return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Profile updated successfully');
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to update profile');
}

// Change password
function changePassword($userId, $currentPassword, $newPassword) {
    $user = getUserById($userId);
    if (!$user) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'User not found');
    }
    
    if (!verifyPassword($currentPassword, $user['password'])) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Current password is incorrect');
    }
    
    $conn = getDatabaseConnection();
    if (!$conn) {
        return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Database connection failed');
    }
    
    $hashedPassword = hashPassword($newPassword);
    $userId = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $userId);
    $hashedPassword = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $hashedPassword);
    
    $sql = "UPDATE users SET password = '$hashedPassword', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '$userId'";
    $result = $conn->query($sql);
    
    if ($result) {
        // Invalidate all sessions for security
        $sql = "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = '$userId'";
        $conn->query($sql);
        
        $conn->close();
        return array('success' => true, 'message' => 'Password changed successfully');
    }
    
    $conn->close();
    return array('success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to change password');
}
